They are placed under another class

121379.subject: Botany
121379.text: What type of genetic material do viruses that infect animals have?
options: Double stranded RNA or double stranded DNA
121379.sol: In addition to proteins, viruses also contain genetic material, that could be either RNA or DNA. No virus contains both RNA and DNA. A virus is a nucleoprotein and the genetic material is infectious. In general, viruses that infect plants have single stranded RNA and viruses that infect animals have either single or double stranded RNA or double stranded DNA. 121458.subject: Botany

Both Assertion are Reason are false
121458.sol: Spores of slime moulds survive for many years as they possess true walls that make them extremely resistant even under adverse conditions.

121623.subject: Botany
121623.text: Among rust, smut and mushroom all the three

121734.subject: Botany
121734.text: What is the composition of the vegetative cell wall in brown algae?
options: Cellulosic wall with a gelatinous coating of algin
Cellulosic wall with a waxy cuticle
121734.sol: The members of phaeophyceae or brown algae are found primarily in marine habitats. They show great variation in size and form. They range from simple branched, filamentous forms (Ectocarpus) to profusely branched forms as represented by kelps, which may reach a height of 100 meters. They possess chlorophyll a, c, carotenoids and xanthophylls. 122054.subject: Botany
122054.text: Given below are two statements: one is labelled as Assertion (A) and the other is labelled as Reason (R). 122484.subject: Botany
122484.text: Aves Features Features A. Type of Bones 1. Hollow with air cavities (pneumatic) B. Type of Skin 2. Air sacs connected to lungs C. Special Digestive Chambers 3. Crop and gizzard D. Respiration Support 4. Dry with an oil gland
122484.sol: Birds have pneumatic bones (hollow with air cavities).Their skin is dry with an oil gland.They have additional digestive chambers: crop and gizzard.Respiration is supplemented by air sacs connected to the lungs.

122667.subject: Botany

122667.sol: Sycon (Scypha) is a sponge and does not perform locomotion. It is a genus of calcareous sponges belonging to family-Scyettidae, Class-Calcaronea and phylum-Porifera. These sponges are small, growing upto 5 cm in total length, and are tube shaped and often white to cream in colour.

122962.subject: Botany
122962.text: If one margin of the appendage overlaps that of the next one and so on, this type of aestivation is observed in :
122962.sol: The condition where one margin of the appendage overlaps that of the next one and so on is defined as twisted aestivation. Cassia shows imbricate aestivation, Calotropis shows valvate aestivation, and Pea shows vexillary aestivation. Answer: Cotton

123515.sol: The cambium present between the xylem and phloem of vascular bundle is called vascular cambium. It is a lateral meristem that gives rise to secondary xylem and phloem and occurs in the form of a thin strip. Vascular cambium is also called fascicular cambium.

123577.subject: Botany

123577.sol: Cells in this stage remain metabolically active but no longer proliferate unless called on to do so depending on the requirement of the organism. In animals, mitotic cell division is only seen in the diploid somatic cells. However, there are few exceptions to this where haploid cells divide by mitosis, for example, male honey bees. 123878.subject: Botany
123878.text: Match List-I with List-II. List-I List-II (A) Failure of cytokinesis after telophase (I) Polyploidy in a single nucleus (B) Disruption of spindle fibers at metaphase (II) Multinucleate condition (syncytium) (C) Failure of DNA replication (III) Beginning of anaphase (D) Splitting of centromere (IV) Cell cycle arrest Choose the correct answer from the options given below:
123878.sol: Failure of cytokinesis after telophase results in a multinucleate condition known as a syncytium (e.g., liquid endosperm in coconut). Disruption of spindle fibers at metaphase prevents the movement of separated sister chromatids to opposite poles, resulting in polyploidy within a single cell. Failure of DNA replication triggers cell cycle checkpoints, leading to cell cycle arrest to prevent the division of incomplete genetic material. Splitting of the centromere marks the beginning of anaphase during karyokinesis.

123953.subject: Botany
123953.sol: Meiosis I is reductional and Meisois II is equational In meiosis I, the division is reductional, while in meiosis II, the division is equational. In reduction division, the chromosome number is reduced from diploid (46 chromosomes) to haploid (23 chromosomes) state. Also known as first meiotic division or first meiosis. The second meiotic division is an equational division because it does not reduce chromosome numbers.

124672.subject: Botany

124672.sol: Ethylene is a simple gaseous PGR. It is synthesised in large amounts by tissues undergoing senescence and ripening fruits. Ethylene is highly effective in fruit ripening. It enhances the respiration rate during ripening of the fruits.

125879.text: What is a common feature of wind-pollinated flowers?

127591.subject: Botany

128865.subject: Zoology

Between the left ventricle and the aorta
Between the right ventricle and the pulmonary artery
128865.sol: The openings of the right and the left ventricles into the pulmonary artery and the aorta respectively are provided with the semilunar valves.
